messages:
compliance-bot: ⚠️ Reminder: SOC2 evidence upload window closing soon. Two-week grace period granted for late uploads related to vendor/contractor attestations. See: https://redwood.share/attestations - please follow the new folder naming convention (org_team_controltype_v3).
Lina (People Ops): Quick update: we pushed a temporary exception path for contractors — Contractor-supplied evidence goes into /contractors/YYYY and must be labeled with the vendor name + scope. This is ONLY for contractor/third-party docs.
Omar (Eng): Thanks — can eng still use the old naming v2 for already-uploaded artifacts or do we need to rename everything?
Lina (People Ops): Short answer: no renames required for already uploaded docs. Only new uploads after today should use _v3. We'll batch-map older artifacts on our side.
Sarah (Security): Clarifying Q: On-prem screenshots for access control — are redacted logs acceptable or do we need original logs in our secure folder?
Noah (Legal): Redacted logs are fine as long as we can show the redaction process and raw logs are retained by the evidence owner (do not upload raw PII into shared drive).
Jamal (Infra): I'll own the infra folder mapping this week. Tagging @Omar since you'll help with node provisioning screenshots.
Omar (Eng): Got it, I'll drop a short checklist in the infra folder: commands run, timestamps, node ids.
Ellen (Contractor Ops): For contractors: please confirm who the evidence owner is in the contractor profile form. We'll email any contractors who missed the original invite with a separate 21-day window.
Lina (People Ops): Office hours scheduled: Thursday 10:00 PT for quick triage (link: https://meet.redwood/attestations-hr). If you need a one-on-one, DM me and we'll slot you.
Sarah (Security): One more: anyone who already attested but later finds missing evidence — please reply here, we'll reopen your attestation for 48 hours.
Omar (Eng): Reopening ticket: I'll need that for our mobile team, will reply with list.
Lina (People Ops): Thanks — small ask: when you upload, add a single-line annotation at top of doc with the control id and owner (example: SC-04 | Jamal). Makes audit review much faster.
compliance-bot: :white_check_mark: Action items recorded: infra owner=Jamal, eng followup=Omar, contractor outreach=Ellen, legal advisory=Noah.
Noah (Legal): If anyone needs help on minimization or redaction templates, ping me. I put a draft in the legal folder.
Lina (People Ops): Appreciated — this should get us over the finish line. Please treat the office hours as priority if you're on the evidence path. :pray:
Omar (Eng): :thumbsup: will be in Thursday.
Jamal (Infra): will upload infra checklist by EOD tomorrow.
Ellen (Contractor Ops): sending contractor batch emails today.
Lina (People Ops): End note: if you're a new hire since Jan 1, 2026, you should complete the micro-training module titled "Attestations 101" — link in the #learning channel.
compliance-bot: Reminder set for 7 days before grace period ends.
